name: Tears of the Lady

angles.text: As a herbalist, you know Lady's Tear for its sticky antiseptic secretion. It can bind open flesh and help prevent infection in wilderness emergencies.
As a priest, you channel the Light to mend mortal injuries. Natural poultices like Lady's Tear can dress wounds when magical relief is stretched thin.

aliases: what is tears of the lady
tears of the lady quest info
faq.answer: Elegael needs help treating wounded companions trapped in Nightclaw Den. Gather Lady's Tear moss in Shadowgale so Elegael can prepare a poultice to keep them alive.
faq.q: What is the quest Tears of the Lady about?

faq.answer: Lady's Tear is a spindly moss that grows near tree bases throughout Shadowgale. Its secretion is viscous and sticky, with natural antiseptic properties that can seal open wounds.

aliases: quest giver tears of the lady
faq.answer: Elegael organizes medical aid in Shadowgale. Wounded companions are trapped in Nightclaw Den, and Elegael needs supplies to treat them.
Nightclaw Den is where several of Elegael's injured allies are stranded near Shadowgale. Their condition is precarious as Elegael seeks healing ingredients.
Elegael needs Lady's Tear's antiseptic secretion to prepare a poultice. The viscous, sticky substance seals open gashes and protects traumatic wounds from worsening.
faq.q: Why does Elegael need Lady's Tear moss?

faq.answer: Lady's Tear clings to tree bases throughout Shadowgale. Elegael has gathered what was immediately reachable, and more moss lies in the surrounding woods.
faq.q: Where is Lady's Tear moss found?

sections.body: Elegael needs your help in Shadowgale. Wounded companions are trapped inside Nightclaw Den, critically injured and waiting for aid. Ordinary supplies are scarce, so you gather medicine from the surrounding woods. Their wounds cannot wait.
sections.title: Desperate Remedies in Shadowgale

sections.body: Elegael needs Lady's Tear, a spindly moss clinging to tree bases across Shadowgale. Its secretion is viscous and sticky, with natural antiseptic properties. It seals open gashes and shields traumatic wounds from worsening in the damp wild. With enough moss, Elegael can prepare dressings to stabilize the fallen.
sections.title: The Healing Moss

summary: In Shadowgale, Lady's Tear moss may keep Elegael's wounded companions alive. They are trapped in Nightclaw Den, and Elegael needs medicine from nearby trees.
